notes.title: WORLD END ECONOMiCA HD episode.02
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9479463/676092e8f6359b503e786d97bae26284281dc4b9.png[/img]

Just released! 

The game now is playable in full HD and adds cross-platform support (Linux/OSX), the art assets are now in 1440p! If you have a compatible display, you will be able take full advantage of the newly remastered art at double the original version's resolution. 

If you're using a 1080p or lower resolution display, don't worry. The game will still run at the original 720p or 1080p without losing any visual fidelity. 

This has been a free upgrade to all current and new customers.

If you want to finish the game on the older engine, please opt in to the krkr_old branch and you should be able to load from the older engine and finish the game there.

notes.title: WORLD END ECONOMiCA episode.02 available in Japanese
notes.notes:
In addition to it's release in English, WORLD END ECONOMiCA episode.02 is now available in Japanese.

For those of you who have already purchased the game, simply right click the game in your library, select properties and change the language under the Languages tab and the game should auto-update accordingly.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - WORLD END ECONOMiCA episode.02, 25% off!
notes.notes:
WORLD END ECONOMiCA episode.02 is Now Available on Steam and is 25% off!*

From the creator of Spice and Wolf, Isuna Hasekura, comes World End Economica. Haru woke up with his life but without his dream. 4 years after the incident, he finds a new cause, as a driven young lady offers him a chance to return to investing and to find justice.

*Offer ends July 28 at 10AM Pacific Time
